map.依据《建筑结构荷载规范》GB 50009-2012：风荷载标准值 wk=βz（风: Per "Load Code for Building Structures" GB 50009-2012: standard wind load wk = βz (gust factor) × μs (shape factor) × μz (height variation factor) × w₀ (basic wind pressure). μz is determined by terrain roughness category and height from table 8.2.1: μz10 for A/B/C/D is 1.284/1.000/0.544/0.262, wind-pressure exponent 2α is 0.24/0.30/0.44/0.60, and the cut-off heights are 5/10/15/30 m (below the cut-off, use the cut-off value). Gust factor βz is estimated here as 1+0.038√H.

map.地面粗糙度按选项选：1=A 类海面/沙漠/海岛，2=B 类田野/乡村/丛林，3=: Terrain roughness is chosen by option: 1=Class A sea/desert/island, 2=Class B field/rural/woodland, 3=Class C dense-building city urban area, 4=Class D dense high-rise city center. Height variation factor μz = μz10×(z/10)^2α (GB 50009-2012 table 8.2.1): μz10 for A/B/C/D is 1.284/1.000/0.544/0.262, wind-pressure exponent 2α is 0.24/0.30/0.44/0.60, cut-off heights 5/10/15/30 m; gust factor βz=1+0.038×√H; standard wind load wk=βz×μs×μz×w₀ (w₀ in kN/m²). wk<0.3 → Grade I, <0.6 → II, <0.9 → III, <1.2 → IV, else V.
map.w₀=0.45 kN/m²、H=60m、体型系数 μs=1.3、C 类城市粗糙度: w₀=0.45 kN/m², H=60m, shape factor μs=1.3, Class C urban roughness (option 3): μz=0.544×(60/10)^0.44≈1.197, βz=1+0.038×√60≈1.294, wk=1.294×1.3×1.197×0.45≈0.906 kN/m² → Grade III (high wind-pressure area); suggest strengthening wind-resistance bracing.
map.按周边环境选：1=A 类海上/海岛/海岸/沙漠，2=B 类田野/乡村/丛林，3=: By surroundings: 1=Class A sea/island/coast/desert, 2=Class B field/rural/woodland, 3=Class C dense-building city urban area, 4=Class D dense high-rise city center. The more open, the larger μz and the higher the wind load; mistaking a city center for countryside severely underestimates the wind load.
